methods.name: Cell-gate cyclic rotation phase refinement and dyadic character checker
capabilities: exact triangular-carrier pivot-gate certificates over rational axial coordinates
typed C12 Cell/gate successor with square equal to the coarse C6 rotation
quarter-turn existence and minimal cyclic refinement tests
C6 to C3 x C2 Chinese-remainder orientation decomposition
exact quotient/remainder phase refinement and carry
normalized cyclic phase-distance compatibility across embeddings
pi-free dyadic half-trace and Viete finite-readout verification
methods.core_law: Interleave each coarse oriented phase state with the unique oriented transition event to obtain a refined successor Q satisfying Q^2=R; every fine state is uniquely 2k+epsilon and the residual bit obeys carry.
methods.hard_boundary: Carrier/phase layer only. Gate events are not native Cell states; normalized phase distance is not the native directed line gauge; deeper midpoint events are formal unless separately realized; the tool does not derive the operation-safe native rotation quotient or the Ramanujan-CM identity.

methods.name: Euler Cayley composition and shared-P double-Pell unit certificate
capabilities: exact rational Cayley composition and doubling
exact arithmetic in quadratic and biquadratic integer bases
verification that the first post-gate dyadic defect has sixth power 99-70 sqrt(2)
verification of inverse positive and negative Pell units sharing P=99
exact inverse-product certificate for the N=58 singular-modulus factors
methods.core_law: For a rotation Cayley coordinate T, composition is T(uv)=(T(u)+T(v))/(1-T(u)T(v)); in the N=58 case T(U2)^6=(99+70 sqrt(2))^-1 and T(V58)=(99+13 sqrt(58))^-1.
methods.hard_boundary: Finite algebraic certificate only. The classical modular-lambda special value is an external input, and the match between exponent six and the six-gate shell is not promoted as a causal modular derivation.
